title: sqrt-negative example and openapi.yaml show a detail text the server never returns
evidence: Verified 2026-10-14 by the task 4 E2E smoke (curl direct on :8080 and through the Vite proxy on :5173) replaying docs/api/examples/sqrt-negative.json: the server returns 422 DOMAIN_ERROR with detail "The operation is undefined for these operands." while the example and openapi.yaml (line 331) show "Square root of a negative number is undefined.". Status, content type, code and every other member match. backend/internal/httpapi/contract_test.go only requires detail to be non-empty, and openapi.yaml says detail is not part of the contract, so no test fails. Task 2 kept a generic DOMAIN_ERROR detail on purpose (review nit left as is).
impact: Low: clients branch on code only; a reader comparing the README or the examples with real responses sees a different sentence for this one case.
precautions: docs/api is changed only in its own contract branch. Either align the example and openapi.yaml with the generic detail, or make the backend detail operation-specific in a backend branch; do not patch one side alone.
verification: After the fix, the task 4 E2E comparison reports no detail differences for the 17 examples.
